title: Euclidean algorithms (Basic and Extended) - GeeksforGeeks
snippet: The Euclidean algorithm computes the greatest common divisor (GCD) of two numbers. Iterative approach: while b != 0, set a, b = b, a % b; return a when b reaches 0.

title: Calculating GCD Using Euclid Algorithm In Python - djangocentral
snippet: The iterative version is more memory-efficient for large inputs than the recursive version, since it avoids growing the call stack.
